description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for configuring and resolving memory search settings within an agent framework, including handling multimodal settings, remote configurations, and merging defaults with overrides.

methods.name: normalizeSources
methods.description: Normalizes the sources array to include 'memory' and 'sessions' based on input and session memory enabled flag.

methods.name: resolveStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for the memory store based on agent ID and optional raw path.

methods.name: mergeConfig
methods.description: Merges default and override configurations for memory search, applying defaults and normalizing settings.

methods.name: resolveMemorySearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves the final memory search configuration for an agent, including validation for multimodal support.
